children: Bawa joins Raymond from the LNJ Bhilwara Group with more than 25 years of experience across investor relations, corporate development and capital markets

Raymond has appointed Salil Bawa as Group Head – Investor Relations for the Raymond Group, with a mandate to lead investor engagement and capital-markets strategy across its listed entities. Bawa will be on the rolls of Raymond Realty. The appointment is effective September 21, 2026.

Bawa joins Raymond from the LNJ Bhilwara Group, where he led group corporate development and investor relations. A Chartered Financial Analyst with more than 25 years of experience, he has worked closely with management teams, global institutional investors and analysts across corporate transactions including demergers, IPOs, QIPs and strategic capital raises.

His previous experience includes building and leading investor relations functions across listed groups, including the Welspun Group. At Welspun, Bawa served as Group Head of Investor Relations and was involved in investor engagement across global markets.

Commenting on the appointment, Rakesh Tiwary, Group CFO, Raymond Group, said, “Salil joins us at a defining moment. Raymond today operates as three focused, listed value-creation platforms, and telling that story with clarity and conviction to global investors is central to unlocking the value we are building.”
Tiwary added that Bawa’s track record and relationships with institutional investors would support Raymond’s efforts to strengthen investor engagement.

Bawa brings experience working with sovereign wealth funds, pension funds and long-only institutional investors, alongside a track record in expanding analyst coverage and institutional participation. According to Raymond, he tripled institutional ownership at Welspun Group within approximately 18 months through targeted investor engagement and roadshows across the US, Europe and Asia.
He has also received the Best Investor Relations Officer recognition, based on a global fund-manager poll, according to the company.

The appointment comes as Raymond operates through three listed value-creation platforms following the demerger of its Lifestyle and Realty businesses into separate listed entities. Raymond’s 2025 shareholder communication confirmed that Raymond Lifestyle and Raymond Realty were separated from the parent business during 2024-25.
In his new role, Bawa will focus on strengthening Raymond Group’s engagement with institutional investors and the broader capital markets across its listed businesses.
